place: Iron Gate II Romanian navigation locks

references.observation: The published river chart shows two separate Romanian chambers in the island channel and the Serbian lock beside the main crossing. It lists the Romanian main and reserve widths as 34 m and 14 m.

The contractor article’s photograph shows stained vertical concrete guide walls with a darker waterline, coping, bollards and pale lighting poles. Individual equipment positions and the exact scene identity are unresolved from this view.
